summary: Full backend + frontend testing of AI BRAWL Phase 1. Backend endpoints (/api/, /api/openapi.json, /api/status CRUD) all pass. Frontend Select→Fight→Exit→Fight flow works: rosters render, selection toggles is-selected, mirror match allowed, fight-button transitions to game-stage with canvas + HUD, HUD names/HP match fighter maxHp (VOLT 80, TITAN 140, WRAITH 100), timer decrements (60→58 in ~2.5s confirming game loop), special shows READY, controls-hint contains A/D/W/S/J/K/L, keyboard events don't crash, exit-button returns to select, TITAN vs WRAITH matchup shows 140/140 and 100/100.

issues: Console warning: Canvas2D getImageData without willReadFrequently=true attribute (perf hint, not a bug). Consider passing {willReadFrequently:true} to getContext('2d').

critical_code_review_comments: server.py imports boto3 and creates an S3 client at import time even though no S3 features are used in Phase 1 — dead dependency/config surface; consider removing or lazy-loading.
Canvas 2D context should be created with { willReadFrequently: true } to suppress the browser perf warning if getImageData is used repeatedly.

Player HP was already 66/80 by the time HUD was first read after clicking Fight — expected because AI engages immediately; not a bug but if a 'ready/countdown' pre-round state is desired, add a short freeze before AI starts acting.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_backend.py (pytest). Frontend automated via Playwright against REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Full round KO end and restart-button flow were NOT exercised (60s round too long, exit-button used instead to validate state reset). If future testing needs result-overlay/restart-button verification, either shorten round timer via engine config or force HP=0 via a debug hook.
